about.en: Canopy is a Web3 framework and mesh-security network for launching sovereign application-specific blockchains (appchains) with little code, where new chains start secured by the Canopy network and can graduate to independence. CNPY is its native token, also issued as a BEP-20 token on BNB Smart Chain (contract 0xC69B16CF18CEA1e5D0bb6a1a9db802097790dDD2).
